title: MiniMax H3 Sol-Turbo — Video + Audio
description: ComfyUI serverless worker for MiniMax H3: executes a prepared ComfyUI API graph for text/image/first-last-frame/reference-to-video with synchronized audio, using the Sol-H3 exact runtime, 8-step turbo LoRAs and multi-window continuation. Returns the generated video plus execution-fact telemetry. Models download to your network volume on first boot.

input.name: Auto-download models
input.description: Download the models listed in models-manifest.txt to the attached network volume at worker boot. Requires a network volume of at least 100 GB (150 GB recommended).

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Optional — only needed if you replace the public models in models-manifest.txt with gated Hugging Face repositories.

input.name: Job timeout (seconds)
input.description: Maximum time a single generation job may run before the worker aborts it. Must be less than or equal to the endpoint timeout.

input.name: ComfyUI boot timeout (seconds)
input.description: How long the worker waits for the local ComfyUI server to become ready.

input.name: Use custom nodes from the volume
input.description: Symlink custom_nodes from /runpod-volume/custom_nodes into ComfyUI. Leave disabled: the worker image already bakes the required nodes.

input.name: S3 endpoint
input.description: Optional S3/MinIO endpoint. Configure S3_* to return large videos as presigned video_url instead of inline base64.

input.name: S3 access key
input.description: S3/MinIO access key (secret — endpoint env only).

input.name: S3 secret key
input.description: S3/MinIO secret key (secret — endpoint env only).

input.name: S3 bucket
input.description: Bucket for large video output (alias: OUTPUT_BUCKET).

changelog:
## v1.0.1

- Fix build/test deployment on Blackwell: `allowedCudaVersions` now lists 13.1 and 13.2 in addition to 13.0. CUDA is backward compatible within a major version, so hosts advertising newer 13.x drivers run the CUDA 13.0 image unchanged; previously they were filtered out and the Hub validator reported no available instances for `BLACKWELL_96`.
- The Hub build test now targets the most available 96 GB Blackwell variant (`NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition`); the health check is GPU-agnostic inside `BLACKWELL_96`.

## v1.0.0

- Initial public release: MiniMax H3 video + audio serverless worker on ComfyUI v0.44.0 (CUDA 13.0).
- Native H3 graph execution with contract `h3-serverless/v1.1`: prepared ComfyUI API graph in, video + execution-fact telemetry out.
- Sol-H3 exact runtime, 8-step turbo LoRAs, multi-window continuation; public custom nodes pinned in the image.
- Network-volume model auto-download (`models-manifest.txt`, `VOLUME_AUTOPOPULATE`) and optional S3 presigned `video_url` delivery.
